title: Cancellation policy and distribution area exemplar

sourceRefs.summary: Run-contract target that explains why this generated contract exists.
Approved quality assumptions and missing-middle phase.
Reviewed near-term category order and preservation boundary.

verification: focused semantic policy rendering compiler and browser tests
allowedWork: Add inferred cancellation intent, recipe capabilities, deterministic policy resolution, typed repair, catalog conformance, and stable cancellation visual checks.
Build only the exact 3(x+2) to 3x+6 synchronized algebra and SVG area-model distribution/factoring reader exemplar, its editor card, responsive projection, and visual gate.
Record evidence against generated-quality-envelope, primitive-amortization, and semantic-llm-boundary while preserving approved fraction behavior.
disallowedWork: Do not promote distribution or factoring beyond the exact exemplar before human approval.
Do not implement radicals, functions, derivatives, WebGL, providers, economics, programming, flashcards, or a general layout redesign.
Do not permit LLM-controlled geometry timing typography or raw ungoverned recipe selection.
goal: Infer cancellation presentation from typed pedagogical intent and measured topology, enforce catalog-wide conformance, and prove primitive amortization with one searchable synchronized 3(x+2) to 3x+6 distribution/factoring area-model exemplar before human promotion.
commitCadence: Commit after each independently verified slice with its Theseus evidence.
stopConditions: Stop immediately if approved fraction visuals or semantic traces regress.
Stop if the cancellation guardrail requires unapproved migration beyond cancellation assets.
Stop if the area-model work broadens beyond the exact 3(x+2) to 3x+6 exemplar.
Stop at the final human visual checkpoint before any family promotion.
Stop on failed verification that requires subjective judgment or unsafe authority.

slices.title: Inventory-cancellation-assets-and-approved-baselines
slices.summary: Pinned the approved cancellation inventory across canonical solve-x, teacher-zero, full fractional, divide-both-sides, balanced transfer, and fluent projection assets; focused tests and typecheck pass.

slices.title: Define-typed-cancellation-pedagogical-intent
slices.summary: Defined and verified a deeply immutable renderer-neutral cancellation intent vocabulary covering contact, approach, identity beat, retirement, and readability without exposing recipe ids.

slices.title: Add-inference-first-cancellation-authoring-API
slices.summary: Added and verified an inference-first cancellation authoring API: callers provide an authorized operation id and teaching goal, and receive immutable renderer-neutral intent with no recipe-id surface.

slices.title: Declare-recipe-topology-and-geometry-capabilities
slices.summary: Declared immutable capabilities for all cancellation recipes, including visible contact, approach, identity beat, baseline topology, contact dimensions, retirement, readability, and source-count limits.

slices.title: Resolve-intent-and-topology-deterministically
slices.summary: Added deterministic capability matching: opposing arcs select counter orbit for shared or distinct baselines, direct convergence selects witnessed annihilation only on a shared baseline, and incomplete or unsafe topology remains unresolved.

slices.title: Return-typed-repair-for-unsupported-combinations
slices.summary: Added a discriminated resolution result with exact source-topology repair, safe two-axis intent repair for distinct baselines, and a manual-review terminal case; repaired intent resolves deterministically to counter orbit.

slices.title: Migrate-cancellation-assets-to-inferred-policy
slices.summary: Removed raw cancellation recipe ids from all six approved cancellation assets. Policy now derives from semantic cancellation transform authority plus one typed teaching goal, uses conservative two-axis topology before geometry exists, rejects mixed raw and inferred authority, and preserves counter-orbit visuals.

slices.title: Formalize-contact-readability-retirement-and-rewind-laws
slices.summary: Added executable laws for stable source identity, full opacity and separation before contact, readable exact two-axis shared contact, complete post-contact retirement, and rewind equality; the real distinct-baseline divide exemplar passes all laws.

slices.title: Validate-every-cancellation-asset
slices.summary: Added catalog-wide conformance for raw recipe authority, missing or orphaned teaching goals, and unresolved policy. All catalog assets plus the five dedicated reader variants pass; the linear-solve/programming composition now carries inferred cancellation intent.

slices.title: Add-stable-cancellation-visual-gate
slices.summary: Added npm run visual:cancellation as a stable repo-owned eight-test gate covering editor-reader parity, counter-orbit selection, distinct-baseline division, seek-rewind, native settlement, static searchability, phone containment, URL profiles, and witness exclusion.

slices.title: Route-generated-cancellation-through-policy-or-repair
slices.summary: Added a strict unknown-input decoder for generated cancellation: authorized operation plus teaching goal and topology produces a governed recipe or typed repair, while recipe, timing, font, geometry, and any other extra fields are rejected.

slices.title: Close-quality-and-amortization-guardrail-tranche
slices.summary: Closed the cancellation guardrail tranche with full deterministic tests, architecture and inference gates, production build, production review closure, and partial experiment evidence; primitive amortization remains open for the exact distribution-area exemplar.

slices.title: Freeze-3-times-x-plus-2-area-exemplar
slices.summary: Frozen the exact reversible 3(x+2) and 3x+6 contract: factor and term dimensions, 3x and 6 regions, KaTeX algebra and SVG area surfaces, canonical forward and inverse operations, and mandatory human approval before promotion.

slices.title: Define-distribution-and-factoring-semantic-trace
slices.summary: Defined a total reversible semantic trace with explicit 3(x+2), 3x+3 dot 2, and 3x+6 states. Canonical distribution and factoring fan out and merge the shared three; exemplar-local arithmetic derives and decomposes six without hiding evaluation inside distribution.

slices.title: Link-algebra-factors-products-dimensions-and-areas
slices.summary: Linked every visible algebraic three, x, two, 3x, and six representation to the exact rectangle height, widths, and regions. The model exposes stable focus concepts while forbidding renderer geometry, timing, or typography authority.

slices.title: Compile-exemplar-local-fan-out-and-grouping-intent
slices.summary: Compiled the semantic trace into existing distribution/factoring fission-fusion plans plus an exact lockstep 3 times 2 derivation/decomposition pair. No layout, timing, coordinates, or typography entered the plan.

slices.title: Plan-wide-and-phone-equation-area-geometry
slices.summary: Added contained wide and phone envelopes with left-to-right side-by-side ordering above 760px, readable stacked page flow below it, minimum area height, and no internal scroll rail.

slices.title: Build-KP-themed-SVG-area-model-with-KaTeX-labels
slices.summary: Added the exact two-region area scene with KP theme variables, shared outline and divider geometry, accessible text, stable cross-surface selector ids, and KaTeX HTML labels for 3, x, 2, 3x, and 6.

slices.title: Render-exact-native-area-model-endpoints
slices.summary: Added native factored and expanded endpoint projections: a unified rectangle labeled 3, x+2, and 3(x+2), and a partitioned rectangle labeled 3, x, 2, 3x, and 6. Both retain searchable KaTeX and exclude material or witness ownership.

slices.title: Synchronize-forward-distribution-and-partition
slices.summary: Added forward sampling that synchronizes factor-copy travel with partition reveal, delays six until 3 times 2 is visible, and assigns exactly one owner at every frame: factored native, transient material, or expanded native.

slices.title: Implement-factoring-as-exact-inverse
slices.summary: Added inverse sampling that decomposes six before factor fusion, uses exact non-crossfading expanded/material/factored ownership, and derives geometry directly from complementary forward progress for bit-exact rewind.
